subject: estimates of covariances for ordered endogenous variables

messages.author: c72fc7caf26ddaca
messages.subject: estimates of covariances for ordered endogenous variables
parts:
I'm estimating a model with a set of ordered endogenous (dependent) variables. A curious result is that the estimates of the covariances of the ordered endogenous variables are zero (as is the Z-value with the P(>|z|) = 1). The output does however include estimates of the standard errors. Note that I am not constraining the estimates of the covariances to be zero. Any help would be greatly appreciated.
 
Regards,
 
Killian.

That is strange indeed. Perhaps this is a bug in lavaan 0.5-16. I will
give it a closer look.

As a workaround, you can use the 'theta' parameterization:

fit <- sem(myModel, data=myData, parameterization = "theta")

Yves.
